triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: The pre-fix module dropped two conjuncts the source requires: the chapter 98 exclusion fired on a properly claimed chapter 98 entry alone, although note 2(j) also requires "whenever CBP agrees that entry under such a provision is appropriate", and the in-lieu transshipment carve-out fired on a CBP transshipment determination alone, although note 2(m) also requires that the product "do not qualify as originating under the United States-Canada-Mexico Free Trade Agreement (USMCA)".
triage.triage_notes: Provision read through the pinned corpus release (us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-174 for note 2(j), page-175 for note 2(m)); both omitted antecedents are verbatim in the source, so this is a confirmed fidelity defect, not a scope expansion. Two distinct defects in one module, both of the same kind (a required conjunct absent from the encoding): (1) rules[fentanyl_energy_chapter_98_exclusion_applies].versions[0].formula gains `and cbp_agrees_chapter_98_entry_is_appropriate`; (2) a new rule fentanyl_energy_transshipment_in_lieu_applies = `not article_qualifies_as_usmca_originating and article_is_cbp_determined_transshipped_to_evade` replaces the bare `not article_is_cbp_determined_transshipped_to_evade` conjunct in rules[fentanyl_energy_additional_duty_applies].versions[0].formula. Direction of pre-fix error: both omissions made the exclusions fire too readily, so goods that the source keeps subject to the 10% additional duty were let out (a USMCA-originating but CBP-determined-transshipped article escaped .13 without landing in .16's 40% in-lieu rate; a chapter 98 claim without CBP agreement escaped the duty). Also changed in the same module, but provenance-only and not defect-bearing on their own: the module summary sentence and three proof-atom excerpt strings extended to the full source sentences. Non-module files in the commit (the .test.yaml with two new witness cases, the encoding manifest, and oracle-coverage-pending.yaml ledger +1 to 2289) are companion/bookkeeping. The PR body (#1195) is the umbrella PR description for the three-overlay encode and does not itself describe this defect; no PR reviews or review comments exist in the bundle, so the commit message is the only quotable statement of the defect.
triage.verifier_justification: The pinned corpus (release us-rulespec-2026-08-03-ecps-pit-tariff-union, provisions file 2026-08-01-usitc-hts-2026-rev3-notes.jsonl) confirms note 2(j) reads "...pursuant to applicable regulations of U.S. Customs and Border Protection (\"CBP\"), and whenever CBP agrees that entry under such a provision is appropriate", and note 2(m) reads "products of Canada that do not qualify as originating under the United States-Canada-Mexico Free Trade Agreement (USMCA) and are determined by ... CBP ... to have been transshipped to evade applicable duties"; the pre-fix formulas encoded neither conjunct. The fix changes executable logic, not provenance: fentanyl_energy_chapter_98_exclusion_applies gains "and cbp_agrees_chapter_98_entry_is_appropriate", and the main rule's conjunct is rewired from "not article_is_cbp_determined_transshipped_to_evade" to "not fentanyl_energy_transshipment_in_lieu_applies", which requires "not article_qualifies_as_usmca_originating" as well. Pre-fix, a chapter 98 claim CBP had not agreed to wrongly escaped the 10% duty, so this is an encoded meaning that disagreed with the source, not new coverage the module never claimed (both carve-outs were already encoded, just under-specified). The companion test adds the two new inputs to every case, confirming a behavioral change rather than metadata churn.
triage.verifier_notes: Refutation attempts that failed: (1) "mechanical/excerpt-only" — the excerpt extensions on both proof atoms are indeed provenance-only, but two formula bodies changed and a new derived judgment rule was added, so the change is not excerpt-only; (2) "not_a_defect / new coverage" — the module's pre-fix summary already asserted both the note 2(j) chapter 98 exclusion and the note 2(m) in-lieu carve-out, so the omitted conjuncts are missing parts of claims the module made, not new scope; (3) "polarity_or_logic" — no boolean was inverted or mis-combined, conjuncts the source states were simply absent, which is unrepresented_clause by the given definitions. One caveat worth a reviewer's eye: for the main rule fentanyl_energy_additional_duty_applies, the new non-USMCA conjunct is partly shadowed by the pre-existing "and not article_is_usmca_duty_free_good" conjunct, so the transshipment half of the fix may be behaviorally near-inert on that one output (it is live on the new fentanyl_energy_transshipment_in_lieu_applies judgment, and the two predicates are not identical — USMCA-originating is not the same as claiming USMCA duty-free treatment under 9903.01.14). The chapter 98 CBP-agreement conjunct has no such shadow and is unambiguously live, which alone carries the confirmed verdict. Note the first reader's quote is from the commit body and is verbatim; the PR (#1195) predates the fix and says nothing about these antecedents, so the commit message is the only narrative evidence, but the diff plus corpus text is self-sufficient.
